problem:
Which of the following vector-valued functions are differentiable with respect to $t$ on $t\in (0,1)?$

$$
\begin{aligned}p(t) & =⟨\sqrt{t},\,2t+1,\,{t}^{2}+2⟩ \\ q(t) & =⟨\frac{1}{t},\,{e}^{t+5},\,\sqrt[3]{t+1}⟩ \\ r(t) & =⟨\operatorname{sec}⁡t,\,t,\,\operatorname{tan}⁡t⟩\end{aligned}
$$

choices.value: None of the functions are differentiable on $t\in (0,1)$
All the functions are differentiable on $t\in (0,1)$

activity_context.topic_title: Continuity and Differentiability of Vector-Valued Functions
